title: _verifyFinalState covers only ~5 of ~25 safety-critical mutations: the 'verified' banner passes over mis-routed donations, unrealizable hook debt, an unprotected staker, or a residual phUSD minter
faithfulnessNote: Closest of the three to a Law-2 spec deviation (the post-condition does not prove the script's own stated end state), but it is NOT a behavioural deviation of a shipped [story-071] FEATURE -- it is an incomplete safety net in the deployment SCRIPT. Kept as a Low operational footgun in the QA/Low bundle, not routed as F-XX; the owner sees it either way. Flag noted here for transparency (Law-1 recall).
description: _verifyFinalState positively asserts only configs(1/2/3) dispatcher+price+growth, configs(7) dispatcher, and RatchetNFTStaker.dispatcherHook -- roughly 5 of ~25 safety-critical mutations. It omits (a) the 4 phUSD minter grants + 1 revoke (incl. OLD_RATCHET_HOOK), (b) the 3 setRecipient(BATCH_NFT_MINTER)+setDonationSplit(50), (c) the 3 Uniboost hook.setRecipient(staker), (d) MultiPooler.setPooler + 3 setAuthorizedPooler, (e) the 3 staker dispatcherHook/depletionWindow/Pauser registrations (the exact UBC-02 case), and (f) NudgeRatchetDelayRelease.setMinter/setReleaser + newRatchetHook.setRecipient. On a clean full pass all ~20 omitted mutations DO execute under their own guards (fork-preview confirmed), so this is a weakened safety net, not a live defect.
impact: None on the happy path (no asset impact; every unasserted mutation executes correctly under its own guards, fork-preview confirmed). The impact is a latent assurance-surface / verification-coverage gap: a silent mis-wire -- the UBC-02 resume-skip, or a hand-edited / corrupted progress.1.json (a workflow the project CLAUDE.md explicitly documents) -- completes with a 'verified' / success banner while donations are mis-routed, a hook cannot realize debt, a staker is unprotected by the Pauser, or an unintended residual phUSD minter remains. It stays at Low rather than trivial-QA because it is the safety net for a real-money mainnet cutover and is the exact detection layer that would have converted UBC-02's silent skip into a loud, caught revert. It does not reach Medium: absent an upstream mis-wire there is no impact, and it neither loses value nor impairs the protocol on its own.
attackPath: Any mis-wire slips through -- e.g. the UBC-02 resume-skip, or a manually edited/corrupted progress.1.json.
Because _verifyFinalState does not assert the affected mutation, the script's post-condition passes.
The run prints 'verified' / success, and the operator walks away believing the end state is correct.
recommendation: Extend _verifyFinalState to positively assert the full intended wiring set -- most importantly the 4 phUSD minter grants + 1 revoke (incl. OLD_RATCHET_HOOK), each Uniboost hook.recipient==staker, each recipient==BATCH_NFT_MINTER && donationSplit==50, the staker dispatcherHook/depletionWindow/Pauser registrations, MultiPooler.setPooler + the 3 authorized poolers, and newRatchetHook.recipient==RatchetNFTStaker -- so the 'verified' banner actually proves the intended end state rather than a ~5-of-~25 subset.
